pins.name: Clinique La Prairie
pins.description: The birthplace of modern longevity medicine, founded 1931. 50+ on-site doctors, cellular revitalisation programs, patented CLP Extract stem cell therapy. Charlie Chaplin, Winston Churchill and Marilyn Monroe were guests. Starting from CHF 19,000 for 7 days.

pins.name: SHA Wellness Clinic
pins.description: One of the world's most complete integrative longevity destinations. Combines epigenetics, neurocognitive therapies, macrobiotic nutrition, and Harvard-level diagnostics. Whole-body MRI, telomere testing. Perched above Costa Blanca with Mediterranean sea views.

pins.name: Lanserhof Tegernsee
pins.description: Global benchmark for preventive medicine and diagnostics. Based on Dr. F.X. Mayr's 1901 gut health cure. Brain Health Centre, INUSpheresis blood-washing therapy removing microplastics. Guests test an average 7 biological years younger after a stay.

pins.name: Chenot Palace Weggis
pins.description: 50+ years of Chenot Method research. 5,000 m² spa with metabolic laboratory, epigenetic profiling, -110°C cryotherapy, anti-gravity equipment. Cellular regeneration on the shores of Lake Lucerne facing Swiss Alps. Altitude room simulates 3,000m for mitochondrial stimulation.

pins.name: Buchinger Wilhelmi
pins.description: World's leading therapeutic fasting clinic. 100+ years, 4 generations, 250,000+ successful fasting treatments. 6,000 guests/year from 60+ countries. Demeter-certified organic kitchen. Nominated World's Best Wellness Clinic 2022. Medical sanctuary above Lake Constance.

pins.name: Lanserhof Lans
pins.description: The original Lanserhof — birthplace of the Mayr method revival. Austrian Alpine setting near Innsbruck. Comprehensive diagnostics, gut health protocols, naturopathy. Cost from $5,000 to $20,000/week. The flagship that started the Lanserhof longevity empire.

pins.name: Palace Merano
pins.description: Italian hub for all things longevity. 5-star excellence meets Chenot Method therapies in alpine South Tyrol. Healing happens not just through treatments but through human connection and Italian lifestyle. A uniquely warm approach to longevity medicine.

pins.name: Palazzo Fiuggi Medical Retreat
pins.description: Grand historic palace turned ultra-luxury medical wellness retreat. Fiuggi's legendary mineral spring waters known since the Middle Ages — Pope Boniface VIII and Michelangelo drank here. State-of-the-art diagnostics meets Italian grandeur.

pins.name: Grand Resort Bad Ragaz
pins.description: Alpine thermal spa resort with natural 36.5°C spring water fed directly from the Tamina Gorge — used since the 13th century. Hyperbaric oxygen therapy, integrative medicine, longevity programs. Olympic athletes and heads of state recover here.

pins.name: Six Senses Ibiza — RoseBar Longevity
pins.description: High-tech longevity clinic in partnership with RoseBar. Real-age and epigenetic testing, IV infusions, CellGym hypoxic training, PEMF therapy, cryotherapy. Data-rich diagnostics and personalized programs. Ibiza's counterintuitive longevity destination.

pins.name: Euphoria Retreat
pins.description: Holistic wellness retreat blending ancient Greek philosophy with Eastern healing traditions. Byzantine architecture meets cutting-edge wellness science. Thalassotherapy, forest walks through Taygetos mountain, longevity programs inspired by Greek mythology.

pins.name: Blue Lagoon Spa
pins.description: World's most famous geothermal spa. Silica-rich 38°C seawater in a volcanic lava field. Clinique at Blue Lagoon offers advanced skin diagnostics and longevity treatments. A UNESCO Global Geopark. Bathing in Earth's living energy.

pins.name: Preidlhof Luxury DolceVita Resort
pins.description: Transformational wellness in South Tyrol's apple orchards and vineyards. Specializes in deep personal transformation, not just relaxation. Award-winning spa, organic cuisine, alpine air therapy. The retreat that changes how you see your life.

pins.name: Vilalara Longevity Thalassa & Medical Spa
pins.description: Algarve's premier longevity destination combining thalassotherapy (sea healing) with medical precision. Seawater at body temperature, algae wraps, marine mineral therapies. 5,000 m² spa complex, anti-aging diagnostics, longevity programs on the Atlantic coast.

pins.name: Hum2n
pins.description: London's leading precision longevity clinic. Team includes oncologists, rheumatologists, cardiologists. Stem cell facials, exosome hair therapy, biological age diagnostics. Not fast fixes — future-proofing your body with data-driven insights.

pins.name: MAYRLIFE Altaussee
pins.description: Vogue's top 10 spa. Personalized Mayr Medicine on pristine alpine lake. Detox, sleep optimization, weight loss. Forest air, glacial water, dramatic Styrian Alps. Where gut health meets mountain silence.

pins.name: Lefay Resort & SPA Lago di Garda
pins.description: Italian 5-star eco-resort overlooking Lake Garda. 3,800 m² spa based on Chinese medicine principles. Olive grove setting, organic cuisine, longevity programs blending Taoist philosophy with Western medicine. Voted one of the world's best wellness hotels.

pins.name: Terme di Saturnia
pins.description: Ancient Roman thermal springs flowing at 37.5°C since Etruscan times. Legend says Saturn threw a lightning bolt creating the springs. Sulfurous mineral water cascading over travertine waterfalls. Free public pools alongside luxury 5-star spa resort.

pins.name: Adler Thermae Spa & Relax Resort
pins.description: Medieval thermal village with Etruscan and Roman roots. The central piazza IS a thermal pool — unchanged since the 15th century when Lorenzo de Medici came to bathe. 5-star spa built around the historic thermal springs of Val d'Orcia UNESCO landscape.

pins.name: Kurotel Longevity Medical Center
pins.description: NOTE: Listed for reference — Latin America's oldest longevity center, founded 1982 in Brazil, European Alpine architecture. Benchmark for integrated medical wellness outside Europe.

pins.name: Zulal Wellness Resort by Chiva-Som
pins.description: Middle East's largest and first dedicated wellness resort. 280,000 m² of pristine coastal land. 400+ therapies including Traditional Arabic & Islamic Medicine (TAIM) — cupping, herbal medicine, hijama. Chiva-Som's global expertise meets Arab healing tradition. Condé Nast Traveler Best Destination Spa.

pins.name: The Longevity Suite Dubai
pins.description: Europe's most advanced biohacking clinic network's Dubai outpost. Cryotherapy, HIFU, electromagnetic muscle stimulation. City clinic dedicated to physical and mental wellbeing — the same brand as Istanbul's Longevity Suite.

pins.name: Pura Longevity Clinic
pins.description: World's first clinic licensed under Abu Dhabi's Healthy Longevity Medicine Centre (HLMC) framework — the globe's first regulatory standard dedicated solely to preventive and longevity medicine. AI-enabled personalized treatment, disease prevention, lifestyle assessment.

pins.name: AEON Clinic at Atlantis The Royal
pins.description: Premium regenerative medicine clinic inside Dubai's most iconic ultra-luxury hotel. Cutting-edge longevity diagnostics, regenerative therapies, biohacking protocols. Where the world's wealthiest wellness travelers converge.

pins.name: DNA Health & Wellness Clinics
pins.description: Futuristic health optimization, longevity, and aesthetic treatments across Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Genetic testing, epigenetics, personalized health roadmaps. Pioneering the GCC's precision longevity medicine space.

pins.name: Kempinski Hotel Ishtar Dead Sea — Ishtar Spa by Resense
pins.description: Jordan's best hotel spa — award-winning every year. 10,000 m², 20 treatment rooms, largest hydro-pool on the Dead Sea. Mineral-rich Dead Sea mud and salt therapies. Private lemon garden with 700-year-old olive trees. The Dead Sea: 400m below sea level, richest mineral water on Earth.

pins.name: Dead Sea Marriott Resort & Spa
pins.description: World-class Dead Sea spa harnessing the most mineral-rich water on Earth. Traditional Dead Sea mud body wraps, salt scrubs, floating therapy. 400m below sea level — highest oxygen concentration on the planet. Longevity through Earth's most ancient mineral therapy.

pins.name: Ma'in Hot Springs Resort & Spa
pins.description: Geothermal mineral waterfalls cascading into natural pools at 45-60°C — impossible to replicate. Biblical healing waters mentioned in ancient texts. Combined with Dead Sea minerals 30 minutes away. Jordan's wild thermal paradise inside a dramatic canyon.

pins.name: Longevity Wellness Hub Dubai (DIFC)
pins.description: GCC's pioneering biohacking and longevity hub. Quantum body scanning, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, red light therapy, ice baths. Founded by explorer Dani Afiouni. GCC's first mobile ice bath unit. $4M raised for GCC expansion across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh.

pins.name: Clinique La Prairie Longevity Hub Doha
pins.description: Clinique La Prairie's Middle East expansion — the iconic Swiss longevity pioneer now in Doha. Part of the global 40-hub expansion plan after 90 years as a Swiss-only brand. Same cellular revitalisation approach Charlie Chaplin and Winston Churchill used.

pins.name: Royal Mansour Marrakech Spa
pins.description: King Mohammed VI's personal palace turned ultra-luxury retreat. 2,500 m² spa with traditional Moroccan hammam, argan oil rituals, ghassoul clay treatments. Artisans spent years hand-crafting every tile. Where North African hammam tradition meets absolute royalty.

pins.name: La Mamounia Spa
pins.description: Legendary since 1923. Winston Churchill painted here. 2,500 m² spa with Moroccan hammam, Atlas mountain rhassoul mud, argan and rose rituals. Set in UNESCO-listed medina gardens. One of the world's most iconic wellness addresses.

pins.name: Amanjena
pins.description: Aman's Morocco flagship — Moorish rose-pink pavilions and basins inspired by ancient Islamic water culture. Traditional hammam, argan body treatments, mint and rose therapies. Marrakech longevity route through ancient Moroccan botanical medicine.

pins.name: Kasbah Tamadot — Richard Branson's Retreat
pins.description: Richard Branson's Moroccan retreat in the High Atlas Mountains. Traditional Berber wellness practices, mountain air therapy, Moroccan hammam. 2,000m altitude for natural altitude therapy. Panoramic Atlas views, organic Berber cuisine.

pins.name: Hammam Dar el-Bacha
pins.description: Marrakech's most magnificent historic hammam, built in 1905 inside Dar el-Bacha palace. Enormous central hall with star-shaped skylights, Moorish tilework. Fully restored and reopened as a public hammam museum. The apex of North African bath culture.

pins.name: Anantara Qasr al Sarab Desert Resort Spa
pins.description: Desert longevity in the world's largest sand desert. Spa inspired by ancient desert healing traditions — sand exfoliation, Arabian oud rituals, date oil therapies. Silence and solitude as medicine. Circadian rhythm reset through natural desert light cycles.

pins.name: Anantara Al Jabal Al Akhdar Resort
pins.description: Perched 2,000m above sea level in Oman's Green Mountain. Natural altitude therapy, rose valley views. Oman's ancient frankincense wellness tradition — used for 4,000 years. Pristine mountain air, cooler climate, stunning wadis. One of the most dramatic wellness locations on Earth.

pins.name: Six Senses Zighy Bay
pins.description: Accessible only by boat, paraglider, or 4WD through mountain pass. Isolated Omani fishing village turned world-class longevity retreat. 9,500 m² spa, frankincense rituals, Omani herbal medicine. Total digital detox by design. Six Senses longevity methodology in pristine Arabian Sea setting.

pins.name: Buchinger Wilhelmi Marbella
pins.description: The Mediterranean sister clinic to Buchinger Wilhelmi Lake Constance. Same 100-year therapeutic fasting method on the Costa del Sol. Team of 20+ doctors. 60+ nursing staff. Mediterranean diet combined with therapeutic fasting — the ultimate longevity combination.

pins.name: Brenners Park Hotel & Spa — Villa Stéphanie
pins.description: Germany's most legendary spa hotel — 150+ years. Villa Stéphanie medical spa offers digital detox rooms with wifi blockers in walls. Baden-Baden's Roman thermal baths legacy. Medical diagnostics, regeneration programs in Europe's oldest thermal spa city.

pins.name: Caracalla Therme
pins.description: Named after Roman Emperor Caracalla who bathed in Baden-Baden's thermal springs in 213 AD. 1,800-year thermal tradition. 900 m² indoor/outdoor thermal pools, 8 saunas, Roman-Irish bath ritual. Germany's most visited thermal spa complex.

pins.name: Therme Vals (7132 Hotel)
pins.description: Peter Zumthor's architectural masterpiece — a UNESCO-recognized stone building grown organically from the mountain. 60,000-litre thermal pools in Valser quartzite stone. Whisper-quiet, meditative bathing experience. Goethe thermal water at 30-32°C. Art and longevity in perfect stone silence.

pins.name: Hammam Al Andalus
pins.description: Moorish hammam restored in the shadow of the Alhambra palace. Al-Andalus bathing tradition — 800 years of Moorish wellness culture in Spain. Hot, warm and cold marble pools, star-shaped skylights, argan massage. The bridge between Moroccan and Turkish hammam heritage.

pins.name: SHA Wellness Clinic Mexico
pins.description: SHA's renowned method meets Caribbean luxury. Same Harvard-level diagnostics, macrobiotic nutrition, epigenetics as Spain — now on the Caribbean coast. SHA's global expansion showcases longevity tourism going worldwide.

pins.name: Progevita
pins.description: Spain's best-value longevity clinic — full diagnostics, hormone profiles, biological age testing, NAD infusions, hyperbaric oxygen, personalized medical consults. From €1,990 for 3 days. Mallorca sunshine and Mediterranean diet amplify clinical longevity protocols.

pins.name: Aman Amanruya
pins.description: Aman's Aegean sanctuary — private stone cottages in ancient olive grove above turquoise bay. 1,700 m² spa, hammam, traditional Aegean herbal treatments. Where Aman's global longevity philosophy meets Türkiye's ancient Anatolian wellness heritage.

pins.name: Therme Wien
pins.description: Europe's largest urban thermal spa — 155,000 visitors/month. 25 different pools, 10 saunas. Vienna's underground thermal springs discovered 1908. Habsburg bathing culture meeting 21st-century wellness. The world's most visited city thermal spa.

pins.name: Hévíz Thermal Lake
pins.description: The world's largest biologically active thermal lake. 4.4 hectares, naturally maintained at 33-38°C year-round — even in winter. Used for healing since Roman times. Rich in sulfur, CO2, mineral salts. You can swim outdoors in a thermal lake in the snow.

pins.name: Al Fayrooz Lounge & Spa — Jumeirah Al Qasr
pins.description: Arabian palace wellness experience inspired by ancient Gulf healing traditions. Date and honey body rituals, Arabic oud therapies, traditional falaj water rituals. The longevity wisdom of desert civilizations in an opulent Jumeirah setting.

pins.name: Anantara Eastern Mangroves Abu Dhabi — Spa
pins.description: Unique urban wellness in Abu Dhabi's UNESCO-recognized mangrove forest. Kayaking through mangroves as moving meditation, marine-based longevity treatments. Salt air therapy, mangrove forest bathing. Nature longevity in the heart of the Gulf's capital.
